page.intro.p1: Map of automated external defibrillators (AEDs) in France, based on the official national Géo'DAE database. Filter by access (24/7, limited or unknown hours), by maintenance and by suitability for children, or start the emergency search, which suggests several defibrillators according to the time, the probable condition of the defibrillator and the person to be helped (adult or child).
page.intro.p2: In a life-threatening emergency, first call 112 or 15 (SMS: 114). Guide: this site, its data and its limits.
page.sim.position: The search starts from where you are (your GPS position), or from the address or point you give with “Change my location”.
page.urgence.bar: Emergency: first call 112 or 15 (SMS: 114).
